senses.gloss:
OMEN (subs.):
(1) निमित्तम्, good and bad o. s:
शुभाशुभानि निमित्तानि, V. m.;
(2) शकुनम्, -नः
(properly from birds), सर्वशकुनसंग्रहः, V. m.
86. 4.;
(3) by adj. (when the meaning is
clear),
good o.:
शुभम्, इष्टम्, शस्तम्, etc.: v. Also
portent.

OMEN (v.): कथयति: v. To betoken. Well-
o. ed, ill-o. ed: v. Auspicious, inauspicious.
